summary: This 8-K filed by Palmer Square Capital BDC Inc. merely discloses management's unaudited estimate of net asset value per share as of June 30, 2026, which was $13.21. It does not announce or relate to any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. The filing is a routine NAV update and does not constitute a special situation.
